recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered psychedelic illustration featuring a central ornate gold frame containing a photographic subject, surrounded by stylized sunburst rays, stippled clouds, and a green stepped border. The style utilizes heavy black ink outlines and fine dot-work (stippling) for shading, characteristic of early 1970s soul and funk aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric framing elements radiating from a central photographic focal point.
Contrast between organic, puffy cloud forms and rigid, geometric stepped borders.
Interaction between flat color fills and dense stippled gradients for depth.
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink outlines on all illustrated elements.
Pointillist stippling for all shadows and gradients.
A palette dominated by lime green, golden yellow, and magenta pink.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central circular photographic portrait within an ornate golden frame, occupying approximately 30% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The golden ornate frame with floral embellishments at the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central photo, move upward to the arched banner text, and then radiate outward along the sunburst lines to the cloud-filled corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with patterns, rays, and clouds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lime green used for the outer border and banner background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow used for the central frame and sunburst rays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and purple used for the puffy, stippled clouds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with a medium value range; shadows are created through black ink density rather than darker color pigments.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Letters follow a curved baseline along an arched banner.
Thick vertical strokes with slightly flared terminals.
Tight kerning with letters almost touching.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'P' with a large, rounded bowl.

composition.position: Upper third, inside a green banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text is a smaller, simpler sans-serif placed inside the frame or above the banner in parentheses.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed proportions.
Provides the necessary visual weight and tight spacing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1970s psychedelic illustration. Central ornate gold frame with floral corners. Inside the frame, a circular photo of a group of people. Surround the frame with radiating sunburst lines in yellow and orange. Add puffy, stippled clouds in pink and purple at the top corners. Enclose everything in a lime green stepped geometric border. Use heavy black ink outlines and stippled shading throughout.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a curved green banner across the top third. Place heavy, black, condensed sans-serif text following the arc of the banner. Add secondary smaller sans-serif text centered above the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the shading achieved through black dots (stippling)?
Is the main text following a curved banner path?
Are there heavy black outlines on all illustrated elements?

adjustableVariables: Color of the outer stepped border
mustRedesign: Any corporate logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent black ink outlines.
Ensure the sunburst rays align to the center of the frame.
Verify the stippling is visible in the cloud shadows.
Confirm the text is warped correctly to the banner arc.
recipe.reuseFormula: Psychedelic Soul Frame = (Ornate Gold Frame + Central Photo) + (Radiating Sunburst * Stippled Clouds) + (Arched Banner + Heavy Condensed Sans) / (Stepped Green Border + Ink Outlines)
